title: What Happens If You Hold In a Sneeze

sections.name: What Happens If You Hold In a Sneeze
lines: This guy is about to hold in a sneeze. That's a really bad idea.
A sneeze is your body blasting air out of your nose and mouth, to get rid of whatever's tickling inside.
Pinch your nose and shut your mouth, and all that pressure has nowhere to go.
It can shoot up the tubes that link your throat to your ears, and in rare cases, burst an eardrum.
It can even pop tiny blood vessels in your eyes.
In 2018, a man in England tore the back of his throat doing this, and spent a week in hospital.
So doctors say, just let it out. Into your elbow.
And no, your eyes won't pop out if you sneeze with them open.
